title: Simon Magus levitating and Peter and Paul

tellings.quote: you know there's a a biblical story of Simon of Maggus who uses like black magic to levitate and then he sees Peter and Paul

plain: In an old Christian legend, a magician named Simon Magus uses black magic to float in the air, and then meets the apostles Peter and Paul. Michels brings it up himself, calling it a biblical story, while talking with a guest about hidden forces in history. He tells it as an ancient account of a man defying gravity.
